q1_issues.issue: "of Karen" in "the help of Karen" is emitted as a thematic Agent on a nominal witness, where the genitive-NP rule maps an of-phrase that is neither partitive, measure nor about-phrase to (Possession sk_help_1 karen).

Karen, the animate co-participant in the building and the taking, carries no role in either event — she is attached only to an abstract help witness, so the comitative CoAgent/Instrument test never reaches her.

q2_gaps: Subjective/agentive "of" on a nominalization ("the help of Karen" = Karen helps): the of-phrase rule enumerates possessive, partitive, measure and about readings and has no case for an argument of a nominalization.

"with the help of X" as a comitative: the Instrument-vs-CoAgent split is stated for a with-phrase whose object is the tool or the co-participant, not one whose object is an abstract nominalization naming a person's contribution.

Appositional/naming "of" ("the identity of Herald", i.e. the identity that IS Herald): the same enumeration has no case for it, so it falls through to the opaque Possession form as if Herald owned the identity.
notes: The narrative-present clauses correctly carry no status atom, build takes Patient and take takes Theme per the change-of-state test, and the fronted adjunct is replicated onto both coordinated VPs as the coordination rule prescribes.
